about_the_game:
Mirai's Midnight Stream — Deluxe OST

A complete collection of 27 in-game tracks and the main theme. Experience the auditory allure of the fox spirit's world over and over again!

This original soundtrack blends soothing traditional Japanese melodies with sultry jazz rhythms. Each piece represents a precious moment shared with the fox spirit. Let the music take you back through unforgettable memories, offering an immersive and emotional listening experience.
